label: original-phase input of z/1/p/o/f/q (t>0)
explanation: Low end of candidate unit 22. Fires mainly in the original (input) phase, about 83% of activation mass, when the input token is one of z, 1, p, o, f, q. z has the highest rate (22%), then 1, p, o, f, q. It never fires at t=0 and almost never on the delimiter. Fire rate goes up at later original positions (orig_idx 8 has 3x lift). The largest activations are z (or p/1/f) inputs late in the original sequence, especially when the sequence starts with y or contains y/j/k/r/h/b earlier. Requiring an earlier y/j/k/r/h/b raises precision from 0.34 to 0.49 but lowers recall. The predicate is coarse: only about a third of z/1/p/o/f/q original-phase steps are active, so prefix context in the hidden state gates it. There is a weaker copy-phase component (17% of mass), led by steps that output y (30% rate) or j. Dev F1 0.43, mass recall 0.70.
